steps.text: Enter the Lumbridge Castle basement.
Go down the staircase.
Go up to the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
choices: Can you show me the way out of the mines?

steps.text: Go up to the surface.
Go downstairs.
Talk to Sigmund in Lumbridge Castle.
Talk to Hans who is roaming around the castle.
choices: Do you know what happened in the cellar?

steps.text: Talk to Bob in the south of Lumbridge.
choices: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?

steps.text: Talk to the Cook, Hans, Father Aereck, and Bob in Lumbridge until one tells you about seeing a goblin.
Talk to Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle.
choices: Hans says he saw something in the cellar
Bob says he saw something in the cellar
Father Aereck says he saw something in the cellar
The cook says he saw something in the cellar

steps.text: Use a pickaxe on the rubble in the Lumbridge Castle basement.
Enter the hole in Lumbridge Castle's basement.
Pick up the brooch on the floor.
Show the brooch to Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle.
Search the north west bookcase in the Varrock Castle Library.
Read the entire goblin symbol book.
Talk to the Goblin Generals in the Goblin Village.
choices: Have you ever heard of the Dorgeshuun?
Well either way they refused to fight
Well I found a brooch underground...
Well why not show me both greetings?

steps.text: Travel through the tunnels. Make sure you follow the marked path, or you'll be dropped into a hole and your light source extinguished!
Perform the Goblin Bow emote next to Mistag and talk to him.
Travel through the tunnels under Lumbridge until you reach Mistag.
Talk to Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle. You can fast-travel with Mistag back to Lumbridge.
choices: I've made contact with the cave goblins...

steps.text: Pickpocket Sigmund for a key.
Open the chest in the room next to the Duke's room.
Enter the H.A.M lair west of Lumbridge and search a crate in its entrance for the silverware.
Take the silverware to Duke Horacio.
choices: I found the missing silverware in the HAM cave!

steps.text: Travel with Kazgar to shortcut to Mistag.
choices: Can you show me the way to the mines?

steps.text: Travel through the tunnels until you reach Mistag, and give him the treaty.

rewards: Access to Nardok's Bone Weapon Store
